card.name: Small words before an upcoming F-term
card.fires_on: No single word type; it fires on scattered small linking words such as of, to, the, as and this in running prose, plus an opening quote bracket.

modes.label: Linking words in prose
modes.description: Short connecting words like to, of, the, as in general narrative or religious text.
modes.example: many of those interned at Gurs fell ill and died due<< to>> the insufficient food and medical supplies as well

card.writes: It slightly promotes fil- word starts and suppresses -F endings, but the effect is not clearly tied to the contexts.
card.plain: It shows no clear pattern; it fires on assorted small connecting words in ordinary text.
